facts.text_zh: 接近目标高度最后2000ft且有邻近航空器时，合理控制升降率并持续监控冲突趋势；发生RA时严格执行现行程序。
facts.text_en: When within the final 2000ft approaching the target altitude with nearby aircraft, appropriately control the vertical rate and continuously monitor conflict trends; in the event of an RA, strictly follow current procedures.

facts.text_zh: 指挥指令为直飞A点，注意进近准备时相应的定位点输入，且短五边目视进近时能量管理需要注意，如果后续无法目视跑道需管制雷达引导，因为31号附近地形原因，雷达引导会使剖面逐渐紧张，注意减速和能量管理，避免飞机能量过大。
facts.text_en: If ATC clears the aircraft direct to Point A, ensure the corresponding waypoint is correctly entered during approach preparation. Particular attention should be paid to energy management during a short-final visual approach. If visual reference to the runway cannot subsequently be maintained, radar vectors will be required. Due to terrain near Runway 31, radar vectoring may progressively compress the descent profile; therefore, manage speed and aircraft energy early to avoid an excessive-energy condition.
